between_attempt_learning: ROUTE continues through receiver recovery and can advance objectives without a separate tap.
Tap the remaining visible coil and reposition when its percentage does not change.
Long fire holds waste ammunition during armored phases.

scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 playable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 9 excellent with minor friction; 10 exceptional. Scores assess only observed emulated mobile play, independent of wins.

reasons.overall_mobile: Two complete, understandable missions with useful touch assists and a coherent atmosphere; crowded landscape UI, recovery handoff and coil-face uncertainty limit fluency.
reasons.controls: Two-contact route/fire, contextual hold, tap aim and threat turn were effective. Manual strafe worked. Recovery needs release/re-hold; fine continuous aim, AIM, DASH, JUMP and tools were not thoroughly assessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, numbered armored/exposed coils and upload provided a readable progression with pressure and recovery opportunities. Offscreen threats and wasted armored-phase fire created friction. Route assistance carried much navigation, limiting assessment of unassisted traversal depth.
reasons.presentation: Strong rain-soaked station identity, teal/amber vocabulary, distinct receiver signage and clear terminal composition. Software rendering and absent audio assessment limit the judgment.
reasons.usability: Concise visible handbook, pausing planning map, context labels, supplies warning and explicit START FRESH were helpful. The save-to-travel handoff caused a costly misunderstanding.
reasons.readability: Primary health, ammo, objectives and terminal totals readable; dark machinery, small coil numbers, compact warning text and dense result details need attention at this size.

unassessed: Physical-device touch comfort and finger occlusion
Recovered memory prose and narrative payoff
